title: Sentence Similarity
description: Determine if two sentences are similar based on a list of similar word pairs.
pseudocode:
1. If sentence1.length != sentence2.length, return false
2. Create a map of similar word pairs
3. For i from 0 to length-1:
4.   If words are equal, continue
5.   If pair exists in map, continue
6.   Return false
7. Return true

steps.note: Check sentence lengths: [great, acting, skills] and [fine, drama, talent] have length 3.
Comparing i=0: 'great' and 'fine'. They are similar in pair set.
Comparing i=1: 'acting' and 'drama'. They are similar in pair set.
Comparing i=2: 'skills' and 'talent'. They are similar in pair set.
All words compared successfully, returning true.
